raw.rationale: ABT-737 is a BCL-2/BCL-xL/BCL-w inhibitor whose single-agent cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM for 5 days is strongly dependent on BCL-2 family dependence, with the highest sensitivity expected in hematologic lineages (not listed) and in small-cell lung cancer and some neuroendocrine/skin lines; most solid lineages show limited selective killing, so probabilities are low and anchored near the 0.2-2.5% base rate with modest upward adjustment for lung and central_nervous_system.
